purpose: Lists the values of one entitlement code map, paged and filtered.

params.name: id
params.values: code map id, Base64-encoded (the server decodes it before the lookup)

params.name: q
params.values: '*' returns all values; a value starting or ending with '*' is used as given; anything else is searched as *value*. Default 'default' (so it searches *default*)

notes: An unknown id is not an error: it answers 200 with arraySize 0. The lab has no entitlement code maps (no drivers with entitlements in the catalog), so every id tried came back empty. A blank id gives 489. The dashboard reads codeMapValues from the answer.

purpose: Starts a code map refresh for every resource-mapped entitlement of the given drivers.

fields.name: drivers
fields.values: list of driver objects; required (an empty list fails with 'no drivers found')

fields.name: drivers[].id
fields.values: driver DN, or the literal 'ALL DRIVERS' in the first entry to refresh every available driver

notes: Not called (it refreshes). The driver key is 'id', not 'dn'. Only entitlements configured for resource mapping are refreshed; if a refresh is already in progress the call returns at once with that entity listed under succeeded and an in-progress reason. Also flushes the driver and entitlement-value caches. Dashboard defines the call (body passed through).

purpose: Starts a code map refresh for the listed entitlements.

fields.name: entitlements
fields.values: list of entitlement objects; an empty or missing list does nothing and answers with no body

notes: Not called (it refreshes). Entitlement key is 'id'. Stops at the first entitlement whose refresh is already in progress and answers with just that one. Flushes caches first.

purpose: Lists the first-level sub-containers under a root (a read despite POST).

fields.name: dn
fields.values: container to list under; wins over everything else

fields.name: level
fields.values: role level number; lists under that level's container; with level 20 the 'System' sub-container is left out

fields.name: type
fields.values: only 'resource' (any case) is checked: lists resource-definition containers under the resource root

fields.name: searchScope
fields.values: 'o'/'one' (one level, the default) or 's'/'subtree'; anything else is 489

example: POST …/containers/container {} → o=data with devices, groups, sa, users
notes: An empty body lists under the user entity's search root (lab: o=data). The dashboard sends {} (users), {id:'',type:'resource'} (resources) and {dn:<role root>} (roles). type 'role' or 'prd' is not special and falls back to the user root. Values are XSS-checked (400).

purpose: Returns the root container that holds provisioning request definitions.
notes: No parameters. The dashboard's catalog pickers use it as the starting point for /containers/container.

purpose: Returns the root container that holds resource definitions.
notes: No parameters. The dashboard's catalog pickers use it as the starting point for /containers/container.

purpose: Returns the root container that holds role definitions.
notes: No parameters. The dashboard's catalog pickers use it as the starting point for /containers/container.

purpose: Counts roles, resources or users (one kind per call).

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

notes: Only one kind is counted even when several flags are true: roles first, then resources, then users. With all flags false the server raises 'Please choose entities to get the count', which reaches the client as a 500 HTML error page. Users are counted in the client's users-list container and capped (hasMore true when the cap is hit) unless VLV counting is on. The lab answered 0 for roles and resources although system roles exist. Dashboard sends users=true&clientId=<client>.

purpose: Exports the workflow database for migration as a zip file.
notes: Not called (migration endpoint). Produces only application/zip, so a request with Accept: application/json gets 406 (seen in the first pass). Requires a provisioning administrator. Not used by the dashboard.

purpose: Imports a workflow migration file.

body.example: multipart/form-data with part 'file' = the exported zip

fields.name: file
fields.values: multipart form part with the exported migration file

notes: Not called (it migrates data). The form part is named 'file' (the reference calls it importDataStream). Requires a provisioning administrator. Not used by the dashboard.

purpose: Lists the Directory Abstraction Layer entity definitions, or one by key.

params.name: key
params.values: entity key; returns that one definition instead of the list

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

params.name: creatable
params.values: true to keep only creatable entities

params.name: editable
params.values: true to keep only editable ones

params.name: removable
params.values: true to keep only removable ones

params.name: viewable
params.values: true to keep only viewable ones

answer: {entities:[{key, editKey, display, isCreatable, isEditable, isViewable, isRemovable, namingAttribute, attributes:[{key, displayLabel, dataType, isSearchable, isRequired, isEditable, isMultivalued, formatType, lookupEntity?, choiceList?…}]}], totalCount:int}; with key: one entity object
notes: Lab has 54 definitions (user, group, container, quick-user-info, user-lookup, many sys-*). An unknown key gives 489 'Internal Error'. The dashboard uses creatable=true&viewable=true for its entity list (lab: group and user) and key=group&clientId=… for group attributes.

purpose: Reads chosen attributes of a list of entities by DN (a read despite POST).

params.name: filterAttr
params.values: comma-separated attribute keys to return; without it only the dn comes back

notes: Missing entityKey: 'Entity key cannot be empty'. Missing userList: 'User dn is not found in the request payload'. A DN that is not of the given entity also gives that message. Not used by the dashboard.

purpose: Returns the key/value pairs of one global choice list (ChoiceDefs).

params.name: key
params.values: choice list key from the driver's DirectoryModel ChoiceDefs (lab: provisioning-category, request-scope, resources-category, roles-category, delegatee-relationship, application-notification)

params.name: locale
params.values: preferred locale for the labels, e.g. en

notes: Without key the server fails with a 500 HTML page; an unknown key gives 489 'Identifier [x] does not exist for this service operation.'

purpose: Delete one or more directory objects.
answer: {success, succeeded:[{dn}]} or {success:false, failed:[{dn, reason}]} with HTTP 200
notes: An object that is not there: 200 with success false and reason 'Entity/object not found: <dn>.'.

purpose: Create a directory object of any creatable entity (user, group, …) from its entity definition.

fields.name: key
fields.values: entity key from GET /access/entities/definitions with isCreatable true (lab: user, group, sys-…)

fields.name: attributes
fields.values: list of {key, attributeValues:[…]}; every attribute the definition marks required needs a value, else 489 'Attribute: <name> is required'

fields.name: attributes[key=container]
fields.values: container of the new object; without it the client's configured container is used

fields.name: attributes[key=cn]
fields.values: naming value; with the container it makes the DN

notes: Also creates a user WITHOUT a password (key user, FirstName and LastName required on the lab): the way to get a scratch user when POST /access/user is refused by the password policy. Same DN again: 489 EntityAlreadyExist.

purpose: Change attributes of an existing directory object through its entity definition.
notes: Change visible at once in GET /catalog/groups.

purpose: Searches objects of one DAL entity, paged, or reads one object by DN.

params.name: searchKeys
params.values: comma-separated attribute keys to search and show; needed when the client has no entity configuration for this key

params.name: entityDN
params.values: returns just that object (with filterAttr attributes)

params.name: isDynamic
params.values: 'true' searches with the definition's searchable attributes when no configuration exists; default false

params.name: isOrgChart
params.values: 'true' uses the org-chart display attributes; default false

params.name: lookupAttr
params.values: 'true' also returns lookup attributes; default false

params.name: advSearch
params.values: ';'-separated key:value terms (e.g. FirstName:a*;LastName:b*); keys must be searchable, non-time attributes

params.name: sortBy
params.values: attribute key; must be one of the entity's display attributes

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

notes: With no per-client entity configuration (dashboard Configuration > Entities) and no searchKeys or isDynamic, the server answers 489 'Entity configuration is missing' — the lab has none, so every plain call failed that way. sortBy outside the display attributes: 'Sort column is not specified as entity display attribute'. Searches for user, group and container returned 0 (lab search roots empty); the entityDN form returned uaadmin. sys-nrf-role with searchKeys=cn gave 'Internal Error'.

purpose: Returns the quick-info card (display name, primary and secondary attributes) for a user, role or resource.

params.name: entityType
params.values: ROLE, RESOURCE or USER — upper case exactly

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

answer: {entityType, displayName, dn, primaryAttributes:[{key, displayLabel, value?:[…], dataType}], secondaryAttributes:[…]}
notes: entityType is compared case-sensitively: 'user' gives 489 'Entity type (entityType:) not supported user'; GROUP is not supported. Missing entityType: 'Entity Type (entityType:) is required'. The dashboard calls it for ROLE and RESOURCE (no clientId) and USER (with clientId). USER attributes come from the client's quick-info settings.

purpose: Lists the columns available for a resource's assignment table (a read despite POST).

fields.name: dn
fields.values: resource DN; the dashboard sends only this

notes: Lab answer: recipientFullName, requestDate, description, statusDisplay, requesterDisplayName, param1 (labelled 'Client' — named after the resource's parameter).

purpose: Returns the attribute schema of an entity, or of the client's user-settings attributes.

params.name: entityName
params.values: entity key (user, group, …) or the special value clientSettings

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

answer: {attributesList:[{key, displayLabel, dataType, isSearchable, isRequired, isEditable, isMultivalued, formatType, controlType}], password?, container?, namingAttr?, displayPhoto?}
notes: Missing entityName: 489 'Internal Error'. The answer carries a field named password (an attribute-name setting, not a credential). clientSettings also returns the user create container (lab ou=users,o=data) and namingAttr cn. The dashboard puts entityName twice in some URLs (…&entityName=clientSettings&editable=true appended to a URL that already has it).

purpose: Returns the attribute schema used for role, resource and assignment lists.

params.name: entityName
params.values: entity key, e.g. sys-nrf-role, sys-nrf-resource, user

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

answer: {attributesList:[{key, displayLabel, dataType, isSearchable, isSortable, isRequired, isEditable, isMultivalued, formatType}]}
notes: The dashboard's own constant puts a trailing space after the name ('sys-nrf-role '); sent literally that gives 489 'Internal Error', so the browser must be trimming or the space is URL-dropped. Without entityName: 'Internal Error'.

purpose: Returns the type and value of one global configuration variable of the User Application driver.

params.name: key
params.values: GCV name as defined on the driver (lab: dirxml.engine.entitl-rs-purge-type, allow-fetch-named-passwords)

answer: {type:str, values:[{@type, $}]}; structured GCVs: values are instances, each {type, values:[{type, values}]}
notes: Missing or blank key: 'Provide the global configuration variable key'. Unknown key: 'Global configuration variable with key x not found'. Not used by the dashboard.

purpose: Delete one group.
notes: A second delete of the same DN gives 489 'Entity/object not found: <dn>.'. One group per call.

purpose: Searches groups (by description) or counts them.

params.name: sortOrder
params.values: ASC (default) or DESC; other values are rejected

notes: Lab returns arraySize 0 (no groups in the search root). The dashboard also appends sortColumn and filter key/value pairs, which this method does not declare.

purpose: Create a group in a container.

fields.name: name
fields.values: the group's cn; missing gives 412 'Value for name is missing'

fields.name: description
fields.values: missing gives 412 'Value for description is missing'

fields.name: members
fields.values: list of member DNs: accepted and echoed back, but NOT added (membership stayed empty)

answer: {dn, name, description, members?, container}: the request echoed with dn = cn=<name>,<container>
notes: Members sent on create were echoed in the answer but the group had no members afterwards (membershipInfo and groupmembers both empty); add them with PUT … membersAction Add. Errors use HTTP 412, not 489. Read back with GET /catalog/groups?q=<text> (it matches the description) or POST /access/groups/groupmembers {dn}; GET /access/groups?q=<cn> answered nothing for the new group.

purpose: Change a group's description and add or remove members.

fields.name: membersAction
fields.values: Add, Delete or Update (any case); required whenever members is sent, else 412 'Specify the action Update, Add, Or Delete on attribute : membersAction'

answer: the group after the change: {dn, name, description, members?}
notes: Add and Delete both took effect at once (GET /access/groups/membershipInfo?userDn= showed the group, then not). Description-only change works without members.

purpose: Lists a group's members, filtered by full name and paged (a read despite POST).

params.name: q
params.values: matched against each member's full name, default *

params.name: size
params.values: page size, default 10; below 1 returns all

answer: {recipients:[{dn, name}], arraySize, total, nextIndex, startIndex, endIndex}
notes: The lab has no groups, so no member list could be shown. A non-group DN or no dn gives 489 'Invalid Group Detected: [dn]'. Sorting is by member name in memory.

purpose: Lists the groups a user belongs to.
notes: Missing userDn: 'Invalid input DN: null'. uaadmin is in no groups, so only dn came back. The dashboard puts userDn both in the URL and in params.

purpose: Lists, per helpdesk access resource, the helpdesk users for a user.
notes: Lab returns six system helpdesk resources (Teams, User Catalog, Reassign, History, Organization Chart, Group) each with an empty users list. Missing userDN: 'Value for userDN is missing in payload'.

purpose: Lists the helpdesk addressees for a user and one helpdesk resource.
notes: Both parameters are required ('Value for userDn/resDn is missing in payload'). Lab answered {} (no addressees). Note userDn here vs userDN on /helpdesk.

purpose: Allocates a new helpdesk ticket number.
notes: Not called: it takes the next number from the server's ticket counter, so it changes state. No body and no parameters. Not used by the dashboard.

purpose: Returns a user's quick info and number of direct reports for the classic org chart.

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

notes: Without dn: 'Internal Error'. A DN that does not exist: 'Id (id:) must be a valid DN …'. The current dashboard uses /orgChart/v2 instead.

purpose: Returns a user's manager chain (hierarchy upward).

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

notes: uaadmin has no manager, so only totalNumberOfReportees 0 came back. Without dn: 'Internal Error'. The dashboard defines it (task approval pages).

purpose: Lists the targets of one relationship from an entity (the org chart 'level up' options), paged.

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

notes: Both dn and relationshipkey are required ('Value for … is missing in payload'). uaadmin has no targets.

purpose: Returns an entity with its related targets per relationship for the org chart.

params.name: entityDefKey
params.values: entity definition key, e.g. user; required

params.name: entityDN
params.values: entity DN; for entityDefKey user it defaults to the signed-in user

params.name: relationshipKeys
params.values: relationship keys from /relationships/list (lab: user2users, group2users); repeat the parameter for several

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

answer: {fullName, entityKey(dn), primaryAttributes, secondaryAttributes, photoAttribute, emailAttributes, entityDefinitionKey, isHidden, isLoginDisabled, targets:[{relationshipKey, relationshipDisplayName, isRecursiveRelationship, orgChartEntityNodes?, nextIndex, total, hasMore}]}
notes: Without relationshipKeys the server falls back to the client's default relationship; on the lab that default is stored as a JSON object, and the call fails with 'Invalid entity relationship key : {"key":"user2users",…}'. So always send relationshipKeys. Missing entityDefKey: 'Invalid input'. Hierarchy depth comes from the client setting hierarchyDepthForOrgChart.

purpose: Runs a predefined global query and returns matching entities (a read despite POST).

fields.name: parameters
fields.values: list of {key, values} for the query's parameters

notes: Missing key: 'Provide the query key'. The lab defines no global queries (/query/list total 0); an unknown key gives 'Internal Error'. Not used by the dashboard.

purpose: Lists the predefined global queries.
notes: Lab answers {total:0}. Not used by the dashboard.

purpose: Lists the relationship definitions usable for teams.
notes: Here key is the full DN of the definition (lab: cn=user2users,cn=RelationshipDefs,cn=DirectoryModel,…), unlike /relationships/list. The dashboard's team pages send their own params.

purpose: Lists relationship definitions of a type, optionally from one source entity.

params.name: sourceEntityKey
params.values: entity key to filter on, default empty (all)

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

answer: {relationships:[{key, displayName, sourceEntityKey, sourceAttributeKey, targetEntityKey, targetAttributeKey}], arraySize, nextIndex, totalSize, total}
notes: Lab: user2users (Manager-Employee, target attribute manager) and group2users (target attribute group). Here key is the short key.

purpose: Tells what the signed-in user (or the user they act for) may do when requesting on behalf of others.

params.name: proxyUser
params.values: DN of the user being proxied for; default empty = self

answer: {authorized, readOnly, teamReadOnly, proxyFor, isAdmin, isRoleAdmin, domains:[PROVISIONING|ROLES|RESOURCES|…], isDelegationTeamMgr, isAvailabilityTeamMgr}
notes: proxyUser must be someone the caller is a proxy for, otherwise 489 SecurityException 'User x is not a proxy for y' (even for yourself). Lab: uaadmin is admin in PROVISIONING, ROLES, RESOURCES.

purpose: Returns the OAuth-related ISM configuration properties the landing page needs.
notes: Lab keys: com.netiq.client.authserver.url.logout, com.netiq.idm.osp.oauth.issuer, com.netiq.ualanding.idmprov.context (URLs/paths, no secrets). The dashboard instead POSTs {keys:[…]} to /rob/ismproperties for other properties (min search characters, VLV).

purpose: Tells which kind of user administrator the signed-in user is.
notes: Lab: uaadmin is globalAdmin true. Not used by the dashboard.

purpose: Delete users.

fields.name: members[].dn
fields.values: user DN; a member without dn fails alone

answer: {success, succeeded:[{id, name}]} or {success:false, failed:[…]} with HTTP 200
notes: A member without dn: 200 {success:false, failed:[{}]} (no reason given). After the delete users/details answers 489 with LDAP -601.

purpose: Creates a user and optionally sets the password.

fields.name: container
fields.values: container DN; default is the configured user root container

fields.name: attributes
fields.values: list of attributes; at least one required

fields.name: attributes[].key
fields.values: attribute key from the user entity; the naming attribute (cn) value plus container makes the DN

fields.name: attributes[].values
fields.values: list of strings; time values as epoch milliseconds, binary (UserPhoto) as Base64 of a valid image

fields.name: attributes[].isRequired
fields.values: if true the first value must be non-empty

answer: password-update result for the new user
notes: Not called (creates). An existing DN gives 489 existing-user. Values are XSS-checked (400). The dashboard builds the body from the create-user form (action 'add', DN values as dn strings).

purpose: Change a user's attributes.

params.name: isProfile
params.values: true when editing one's own profile; default false

answer: {dn, attributes:[{name, key, values?, hidden, dataType}]}: every user attribute with the refreshed values
notes: GET /access/users/details showed the new Title at once.

purpose: Says whether a user is a domain or delegated administrator of a domain.

params.name: level
params.values: 1 = domain administrator (default), 2 = delegated administrator; anything else is 489

params.name: type
params.values: domain, any case: ROLES, COMPLIANCE, PROVISIONING, RBPM-APP, SECURITY (checked); RESOURCES is accepted but always false; PRD, CONFIGURATION, ATTESTATION, SOD, TEAMS, RBPM are rejected

notes: The reference lists PRD as a type, but the server only accepts PROVISIONING for that domain. Missing type: 'Value for type is either invalid or not supported'. Lab uaadmin, level 1: ROLES/COMPLIANCE/PROVISIONING/RBPM-APP true, SECURITY false. Not used by the dashboard.

purpose: Moves or renames a user's DN through the workflow engine.
notes: Not called (changes data). Only a provisioning administrator may call it; others get 400 (security error mapped to the XSS code). Failure to move: 489. Not used by the dashboard.

purpose: Clears the DirXML-EntitlementResult attribute on a user.
notes: Not called (it clears data despite being a GET). Missing userDn: 489 'Invalid input DN: null' (the first pass hit this without a DN, which changed nothing). Not used by the dashboard.

purpose: Returns the signed-in user's basic details as configured for the client (header card, profile).

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

params.name: isProfile
params.values: true for the My Profile page attribute set; default false

answer: {dn, fullName, canHide, imageAttr, primaryAttributes, secondaryAttributes, otherAttributes, disabledLogin, disabledLoginSupported, helpdeskDetails, isHelpdeskUser, teamManger, hideProfilePhoto}
notes: Always about the caller; no DN parameter. Note the field spelled teamManger.

purpose: Searches users whose request history the caller may view (helpdesk).

params.name: columnCustomization
params.values: 'true' applies the manage-users column customization; default false

params.name: clientId
params.values: dashboard client configuration id; defaults to 1 (lab: 1)

notes: Lab user root is empty, so nextIndex -1 and totalCount 0. Callers who are neither domain administrators nor helpdesk users for a client get an unauthorized error. Not used by the dashboard.
